plainText:
Lucca (Japanese: ルッカ Lucca), also referred to as Mrs. Lucca (Japanese: ルッカ先生 Lucca-sensei), is a supporting character who appears in . She is a and Liko's mother.

==History==
===Pre-series===
Lucca grew up somewhere in the Kanto region, where she met Alex when she attended Indigo Academy.

Sometime before the events of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, Lucca met Friede and became his teacher.

As revealed in Flying Pikachu, Rising Higher and Higher!, some years later, she moved to Paldea with Alex and eventually had her daughter named Liko. Lucca introduced Friede to Captain Pikachu, which led them to forming the Rising Volt Tacklers. One day, Lucca was contacted by her mother as she asked her to hire anyone she trusted to protect both Liko and the pendant. Accepting her mother's request, Lucca called Friede and asked him to bring Liko, who was attending Indigo Academy, to Paldea and protect her during the journey there.

===Pokémon Horizons: The Series===
 
Lucca was first mentioned in The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One) by Liko when she talking to her roommate that she befriend named Ann. She and her husband recommended Indigo Academy as the place where Liko would attend in the hopes of finding her goal.

In For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!, Friede mentioned her, where it was revealed that she asked and paid the Rising Volt Tacklers to be Liko's bodyguards.

In Welcome to Paldea!, she was mentioned by Alex, when Liko asked where she was and Alex told Liko that she was on a field trip and couldn't come home that day.

In Arboliva's Forest, Friede mentioned that he was awaiting contact from her. Lucca made her first physical appearance in the next episode. Meeting Friede in a library in Artazon, Lucca told Friede the story about the Ancient Adventurer, and how the story was connected with the two Ancient Poké Balls that Liko and Roy had. Friede also asked her if she knew anything about Liko's pendant since she was her mother, and she told him that she didn't know much about it, as it belonged to her mother, Diana. She also revealed that Diana had given the pendant to Liko as a good-luck charm.
 
In Reunion at the Ancient Castle!, Diana revealed to Liko that she and Lucca had frequent contact about the journey Liko had been on with the Rising Volt Tacklers.

Lucca met Liko again some time before the events of Welcome to Naranja Academy!. During the episode, Lucca and her husband welcomed Liko and prepared her to enter Naranja Academy. Lucca accompanied her during the way to the school, and when they separated, she wished Liko good luck.

Lucca was mentioned in The Three Explorers where Diana revealed that she met with her daughter and she revealed that Liko was traveling to Kitakami with the Rising Volt Tacklers.

In Beyond the Shining Rainbow, Lucca and Alex received a message from Liko on her Rotom Phone informing her that Liko had made progress in her search for the Six Heroes. After seeing the message, she saw Black Rayquaza flying alongside the Brave Olivine.

==Character==
Lucca is a caring mother, who doesn't want to let her maternal-side influence Liko, and prefers her daughter to do things on her own as a way to have her learn about herself. According to her daughter, Lucca has a really short temper, just like her mother and great-grandmother, as revealed in The Three Explorers.
